facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 24 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mt. Tebo
evidence.detail: left April 20; earlier seasons: May 31 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 9 (2025)

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 13 (2024), June 15 (2025)
